summary: Iron County facility page, fee sheet and map read; Campspot 403 (Oct capture used). $43 confirmed (tax included), 50A + water, 31 sites (26 RV + 5 walk-in), one pull-through, showers/flush/dump, Campspot booking from Jan 1; season 05-07..10-17 confirmed with 2027 opening May 14. Coastal-walk upgrade lead; website link redirects.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade, reviewer decides): stored 'not waterfront'. The RV loops (centre ~46.5591,-90.4386; nearest sites 21-26 at ~46.5600,-90.4387) are ~300-400 m on foot from the Lake Superior shore (beaches either side of the harbor mouth), and everything between is the county park's own marina, parking, park road and the creek footbridge - no highway, town, rail line or residential strip. That fits 'coastal walk' (easy walk under a mile to a Great Lake, the park's own day-use areas and roads allowed between). No site is on the water (the loops are under trees on the rise, ~100 m+ from the creek and harbor).
PIN 46.5604,-90.4396 sits at the south edge of the marina/creek, ~170 m from the campground loops (~46.5591,-90.4386): under 250 m, fine.
